zh-Hans: 重新索引包含多个 Git 仓库的目录更快，扫描完成时窗口更流畅。
旧文件移入监听目录后会保留到达日期，同一路径跨天出现时只高亮当天更新的目录行。
快捷窗口固定置顶，打开后按 ↓ 可选中第一项。修复了窗口左上角按钮部分区域点击无效的问题。
en: Reindexing folders that contain multiple Git repositories is faster, and windows stay responsive when scans finish.
Older files moved into a monitored folder keep their arrival date. When a path appears on multiple days, only the updated day is highlighted.
The Quick Panel stays on top. Press ↓ after opening it to select the first item. The full area of each window control now responds to clicks.
